title: Portland owner wins $1.24m after sign firm leaves advertising wall unusable

The jury determined that the advertising agency's failure to return a crucial state permit unfairly impacted Atwood's future income by resulting in a loss of advertising opportunities. An appeals court confirmed the jury's ruling, dismissing Lamar's various defenses. Additionally, Atwood is filing another lawsuit against the Oregon Department of Transportation.

title: Rail worker's $1.73m injury award faces retrial after Texas court ruling
description: In a significant workplace incident, Travis Gozan was injured as a passenger in a utility vehicle. A jury initially awarded him over $1.7 million for medical costs and suffering. However, the appeals court deemed the future medical treatment estimates speculative and lacking solid evidence. Consequently, a new trial was ordered to reassess Gozan's negligence and damages claims, with past and future mental anguish claims dismissed due to insufficient evidence.

After returning from war, he embarked on a beautiful 72-year marriage with Janet Kajano, a woman who transformed his life. They raised four children together, creating a rich tapestry of community involvement and travel.

title: IAF to hold week-long aerial wargames near the LAC

It is scheduled to run from November 13 to 21, focusing on operations near the Line of Actual Control. Aircraft including Sukhoi-30MKI and Mirage-2000, along with transport aircraft, will participate in the drills. The exercises aim to enhance operational readiness in challenging high-altitude environments and validate military concepts.

title: Sophie Cunningham sends NBA a message after Luka Doncic incident
description: Sophie Cunningham recently supported a proposed modification in NBA rules concerning technical fouls, inspired by Luka Doncic's latest incident. Trainer Drew Hanlen proposed that technical fouls should be dismissed if referees overlook a call, a sentiment Cunningham echoed during a podcast debate over Doncic's on-court frustration. As Doncic recovers from a minor ankle injury, his performance is vital for the success of the Los Angeles Lakers this season.

Upon finding the note, the vigilant crew promptly alerted the pilot, who then sought a priority landing at Chennai airport. Enhanced security protocols were enacted upon arrival, leading to comprehensive inspections.

title: SpaceX eyes historic Starship catch as Musk pushes to make spacecraft fully reusable
description: SpaceX is set to make history by recovering both parts of Starship at its Texas launch site. Following the launch, the Super Heavy booster is designed to be captured by mechanical arms, while the upper stage will orbit the Earth for 14 cycles. Recovery is anticipated 22 hours after liftoff.

title: When women aren't safe on India's streets, who can be held legally responsible?
description: Women enduring harassment in dimly lit spaces can pursue justice by utilizing legal frameworks designed to combat such inefficiencies. When police refuse to file complaints and public safety infrastructure falls short, accountability becomes a pressing issue. Victims can explore various legal options for compensation and justice, emphasizing the need for robust public safety measures and effective collaboration among agencies to enhance women's safety in public environments.

description: After a tough defeat to New Zealand in the fourth ODI, Virat Kohli showcased remarkable sportsmanship by gifting a jersey to pacer Matt Henry, who excelled with impressive bowling figures of 6/27. Despite India's struggles at the crease, Will Young's century propelled New Zealand to a total of 333 runs. Fortunately, India still maintains a 2-1 lead in the five-match ODI series with one game left to play.

title: BrahMos blitz: India's cruise missile gets interest from more Southeast Asian nations
description: India's BrahMos supersonic cruise missile is making significant inroads in Southeast Asia with new agreements. The Philippines has already obtained this advanced missile system, while Vietnam has formalized plans for future cooperation. Several other nations are actively engaging with India for potential missile purchases, pending governmental sanction. Older missile models continue to demonstrate high operational reliability through rigorous non-destructive testing.

Laboratory analysis revealed that these creams posed severe health risks due to toxic contents beyond acceptable limits. Officials have issued a public alert against usage, and a legal case under drug safety regulations has been filed.

title: Poland gets Pentagon green light for permanent US base near Russia; 5,000 troops planned
description: Poland aims to make the American military presence permanent, currently hosting around 10,000 American troops. Polish officials plan to accommodate an additional 5,000 personnel through permanent infrastructure development. The investment for this infrastructure is estimated between 15 billion and 17 billion zlotys. Proposed locations for new installations include Bydgoszcz, Poznań, Szczecin, and Wrocław. A permanent deployment would enhance deterrence against potential Russian aggression and improve military coordination.

title: More than 16 hours after global outage, Microsoft still struggling to fix issue
description: Microsoft 365 outage update: Microsoft says recovery work is now complete across parts of its Asia Pacific infrastructure, with mailbox access and delayed email processing improving for Outlook and Teams users. This follows an earlier update reporting ‘incremental improvement’ across several services. More than 17 hours after the outage began on November 12, some users may still face intermittent issues, and there is no timeline for full restoration.

The toll has risen to 23 fatalities, which includes several college students, with numerous others suffering injuries. In response, Assam's Chief Minister and state ministers have arrived to manage the relief efforts.

title: 'Must not fall into Russia's trap': EU's Kallas warns Europe over Ukraine peace talks
description: Kaja Kallas, the European foreign policy chief, has underscored the necessity of establishing a ceasefire in Ukraine. She cautioned that upcoming peace talks should not divert attention towards addressing Russia’s security demands. Kallas voiced her apprehension over potentially falling for Russia’s tactical manipulations. Meanwhile, US special envoy Steve Witkoff mentioned that European representatives would continue in the negotiation process.

With India crumbling to just 89 runs in pursuit of 334, Matt Henry's impressive six-wicket haul underscored their struggle against quality seam bowling. Gambhir noted the critical need for the team to adjust to tough playing conditions, highlighting ongoing batting failures. The upcoming fifth ODI will decide the series, currently led by India 2-1.

Prompt action by law enforcement led to the arrest of Raghavendra Kushwaha, the driver related to a local MLA. Despite fleeing after the crash and the police recovering the vehicle, Kushwaha was released on bail.

title: 1km above limit, camera location Atlantic Ocean: Speed ticket sparks online debate
description: A man received a Rs 2,000 traffic challan for driving at 101 kmph on the Yamuna Expressway. The speed limit in that area is set at 100 kmph, prompting online discussions about traffic enforcement. Concerns were raised about the reliability of AI traffic cameras and the lack of speed tolerance. Other individuals shared similar experiences where fines seemed excessive for minor speed violations.

title: 'No one threw their wicket away': Iyer's blunt response after 244-run defeat
description: Stand-in captain Shreyas Iyer acknowledged the impact of New Zealand’s bowling, particularly Matt Henry's six-wicket haul. India collapsed to just 89 runs while chasing a target of 334 after New Zealand posted 333 in their innings. Iyer emphasized that the Indian batters were dismissed by quality deliveries rather than poor performance. He urged the team to learn from the experience and remain confident from earlier victories.

title: 'My phone tapped': Rahul fires salvo at PM Modi; 'get head examined', says BJP
description: Rahul Gandhi accused PM Narendra Modi of having his phone tapped and renewed his challenge for a face-to-face debate. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav backed his allegation, saying technology could not be trusted in the age of AI. The BJP rejected the charge, with Kerala BJP chief Rajeev Chandrasekhar hitting back at the Congress leader.

description: Beardman also became only the second Australian male bowler to take five or more wickets in his first ODI as England were bowled out for just 131 in the series opener.

title: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan add historic Irish castle to portfolio
description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired Strancally Castle in County Waterford for €51.17 million. The historic estate spans 440 acres and includes a Gothic mansion overlooking the River Blackwater. Its prior owners expressed happiness about the sale and hope for its maintenance. The castle will serve as a family residence during business trips to Ireland.
